body:
# THIS PLUGIN IS NOT GONNA GET UPDATES

# Ly+ TPA

**GUI-based teleportation with dimension awareness for the Ly+ suite.**
A polished `/tpa` and `/tpahere` system with a full request GUI, per-player reception settings, and a smooth action bar countdown — all managed from `/settings`.

> 💬 **Support & Community:** [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/hRWxShEnqa)
> 🔧 **Requires:** [Ly+ Settings](https://modrinth.com/plugin/lyplussettings)

---

## ✨ Features

### 📨 Request GUI *(sender side)*
When you run `/tpa` or `/tpahere`, a confirmation GUI opens **before** anything is sent to the other player. You see exactly who you're requesting and where they are — then decide whether to confirm or cancel.

- 🌿 **Grass Block** — target is in the Overworld
- 🔴 **Netherrack** — target is in the Nether
- 🪨 **End Stone** — target is in The End
- Player head with name in the center
- **Lime** = confirm & send · **Red** = cancel without sending

### ⚠️ Warning GUI *(receiver side, TPA-Here only)*
If a player has the TPA-Here Warning enabled in their settings, they get a second confirmation GUI showing where they'll be teleported to before accepting. Prevents TP-trapping.

### ⏱️ Action Bar Countdown
No chat spam — the countdown appears cleanly in the action bar:
```
✦ Teleporting to Steve  ●●●○○  3s ✦
```
Progress dots fill down as time counts. Moving during the countdown cancels the teleport immediately.

### 🎛️ Per-Player Settings *(in /settings GUI)*
| Setting | Options |
|---|---|
| Auto-Accept | ON / OFF |
| Countdown | ON / OFF |
| TPA-Here Warning | ON / OFF |
| TPA Reception | Everyone · Friends Only · Nobody |
| TPA-Here Reception | Everyone · Friends Only · Nobody |

---

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/tpa <player>` | Send a teleport request |
| `/tpahere <player>` | Ask a player to come to you |
| `/tpaccept` | Accept a pending request |
| `/tpdeny` | Deny a pending request |

**Aliases:** `/tph` · `/tpyes` · `/tpno` · `/tpcancel`

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Default |
|---|---|
| `settings.tpa` | true |
| `settings.tpaccept` | true |

## 📋 Requirements

- Paper or Purpur **1.21+**
- Java **21+**
- [Ly+ Settings](https://modrinth.com/plugin/lyplussettings) **2.0.0+**

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Make sure [Ly+ Settings](https://modrinth.com/plugin/lyplussettings) is installed
2. Download `LyPlusTPA-2.0.0.jar` and place it in `/plugins`
3. Start the server
4. Configure `plugins/LyPlusTPA/config.yml` if needed
